summary: MSA Safety Inc filed an 8-K announcing it completed the acquisition of Autronica Fire and Security for ~$555 million. Autronica, a Norwegian fire and gas detection firm, had ~$160 million in 2025 sales. The deal was financed with cash and credit facility borrowings, expected to be accretive to adjusted EPS in the first full year. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing timeline were disclosed. Watch for integration progress and any regulatory updates that could shift risk-arb spreads.
